tableStructures.users:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('ADMIN','GURU','KETOS','perwakilan') NOT NULL,
  `nama` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `nomor_telepon` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('aktif','tidak_aktif','ditangguhkan') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  `class_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `guru_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username_UNIQUE` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_users_username` (`username`),
  KEY `idx_users_role` (`role`),
  KEY `idx_users_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_users_role_status` (`role`,`status`),
  KEY `fk_users_guru` (`guru_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_users_guru` FOREIGN KEY (`guru_id`) REFERENCES `guru` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=538 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
tableStructures.siswa:
CREATE TABLE `siswa` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_siswa` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `nis` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `nama` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `kelas_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `jabatan` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'Sekretaris Kelas',
  `jenis_kelamin` enum('L','P') DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Email siswa (opsional, bisa juga diambil dari tabel users)',
  `alamat` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `telepon_orangtua` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telepon_siswa` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Nomor telepon siswa',
  `status` enum('aktif','tidak_aktif','lulus','pindah','alumni','keluar') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif' COMMENT 'Status siswa: aktif, tidak_aktif, lulus, pindah, alumni, keluar',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `id_siswa_UNIQUE` (`id_siswa`),
  UNIQUE KEY `nis_UNIQUE` (`nis`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_siswa_nis` (`nis`),
  KEY `fk_siswa_users_idx` (`user_id`),
  KEY `fk_siswa_kelas_idx` (`kelas_id`),
  KEY `idx_siswa_kelas_id` (`kelas_id`),
  KEY `idx_siswa_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_siswa_nama` (`nama`),
  KEY `idx_siswa_user_id_lookup` (`user_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=101 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
tableStructures.guru:
CREATE TABLE `guru` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_guru` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `nip` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `nama` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `mata_pelajaran` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `mapel_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `no_telp` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `alamat` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis_kelamin` enum('L','P') DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('aktif','tidak_aktif','pensiun') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `id_guru_UNIQUE` (`id_guru`),
  UNIQUE KEY `nip_UNIQUE` (`nip`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_guru_nip` (`nip`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_guru_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `fk_guru_users_idx` (`user_id`),
  KEY `fk_guru_mapel_idx` (`mapel_id`),
  KEY `idx_guru_mapel_id` (`mapel_id`),
  KEY `idx_guru_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_guru_nama` (`nama`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_guru_mapel` FOREIGN KEY (`mapel_id`) REFERENCES `mapel` (`id_mapel`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_guru_users` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=29 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
